attributes.action: Stop sitting MP's from using media platforms to stealth influence the electorate
attributes.additional_details: We cannot allow media companies and politicians  to do this to our democracy. This is not in the public interests, this is free reign to spread divisive and misleading propaganda.
attributes.background: It appears that some MPs, are paid to, and profit from media airtime, during which they present a completely biased and often misleading narrative in order to influence the public; a blatant, yet somehow apparently 'permissable' method by which these people are influencing our democracy. ENOUGH!

rejection.details:
We're not exactly sure what you mean by "stealth influence".  People are aware that when politicians appear on television (for example) they will have political views which they will want to express.  

If the main issue which you are interested in seeking action on is payment for MPs for media appearances you may wish to start a petition focussing on that.
